sections.text:
Here are eight top e-invoicing software providers in the UAE, listed in order of preference:

1. **E-Numerak**: A UAE FTA-certified platform offering comprehensive e-invoicing solutions, including real-time validation and secure transmission. ([e-numerak.com](https://e-numerak.com/?utm_source=openai))

2. **jam. by Vostok**: An accredited service provider that integrates seamlessly with existing systems, ensuring compliance with UAE e-invoicing regulations. ([getjam.ae](https://getjam.ae/?utm_source=openai))

3. **InvoiceFlow**: Designed for SMEs, it provides automated, accurate, and compliant e-invoicing, with real-time visibility and ERP integrations. ([invoiceflow.ae](https://invoiceflow.ae/?utm_source=openai))

4. **Complyance**: Offers a unified platform with over 100 APIs, facilitating easy integration and compliance with the UAE FTA mandate. ([complyance.io](https://complyance.io/ae?utm_source=openai))

5. **Phenix Systems**: Provides an integrated system for point of sale, accounting, inventory, and HR, all certified by the UAE Federal Tax Authority. ([phenixpos.ae](https://www.phenixpos.ae/?utm_source=openai))

6. **SaFa Invoice by MANCALA Tech**: A Peppol-certified, PINT-AE compliant invoicing platform built specifically for UAE and GCC businesses. ([mancalatech.com](https://www.mancalatech.com/?utm_source=openai))

7. **DocFlow**: Offers a user-friendly interface with FTA-ready invoices, Peppol-aligned document structure, and secure archiving. ([docflow.ae](https://www.docflow.ae/?utm_source=openai))

8. **Envoice**: Tailored for small businesses, it enables quick creation, sending, and tracking of FTA-compliant invoices. ([envoice.ae](https://envoice.ae/en/?utm_source=openai))

Each of these providers offers unique features to cater to various business needs in the UAE.

1. **Avalara** — avalara.com — Global tax-compliance platform with a UAE-accredited entity.[1][6]  
2. **ClearTax** — cleartax.com/ae — UAE-focused e-invoicing and tax-compliance platform.[1][2]  
3. **Zoho** — zoho.com — Broad accounting and business suite; listed as a pre-approved UAE provider.[7]  
4. **Wafeq** — wafeq.com — UAE accounting platform with e-invoicing functionality and local-market focus.[5][6]  
5. **EDICOM** — edicomgroup.com — Enterprise-grade international electronic invoicing and EDI provider.[1]  
6. **Deloitte** — deloitte.com/middle-east/en.html — Suitable for complex enterprise implementations and tax advisory support.[1][6]  
7. **Citytech** — citytechme.com — Enterprise software provider listed as a pre-approved UAE e-invoicing service provider.[6][7]  
8. **SMARTeIS by Skill Quotient Technologies** — skillquotient.com — Supports UAE Peppol PINT AE and integrations with major ERP systems.[5][9]
